an7.40:1.1: sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu cittaṃ vase vatteti no ca bhikkhu cittassa vasena vattati.
an7.40:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu samādhikusalo hoti samādhissa samāpattikusalo hoti samādhissa ṭhitikusalo hoti samādhissa vuṭṭhānakusalo hoti samādhissa kallitakusalo hoti samādhissa gocarakusalo hoti samādhissa abhinihārakusalo hoti.
an7.40:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu cittaṃ vase vatteti no ca bhikkhu cittassa vasena vattatīti.
